title: Steve Jones (CEO, VeilStream) after the Lenny's Newsletter book club session — 'It's an excellent book that forces companies to question a lot of things that are taken for granted'
summary: The Lenny's Newsletter book club Q&A happened, hosted by Annie Warner. Steve Jones — CEO of VeilStream, and an early Lean Startup adopter who had Eric visit his offices at Pulse Energy before that book was published — writes it up afterwards, and notes the lessons extend past companies to governments and non-profits.
blockquote:
It's an excellent book that forces companies to question a lot of things that are taken for granted about how companies. It also sheds light on the long term cost and consequences (financial and otherwise,) of going with "the way things have always been done."

In addition to being a great book for companies, I think many of the lessons also apply to governments and non-profits.
attribution_title: CEO, VeilStream · Early Lean Startup adopter at Pulse Energy
